Skeletal, petrified druids, long-sworn to vengeance against chaos and mortals. Hate living druids, who siabrae consider cowards for not taking the undead oath.

AC 9, HP 31, ATK 1 staff +0 (1d4 + petrify) or 2 spell +5, MV near (burrow), S +0, D -1, C +0, I +0, W +4, Ch +4, AL C, LV 7

Barkskin (WIS Spell). Self. DC 13. AC becomes 15 for 5 rounds.

Conjure Flames (WIS Spell). DC 12. One target in far takes 2d6 damage.

Greater Undead. Immune to morale checks. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

Imbue (WIS Spell). Self. DC 13. Staff becomes a +3 magic weapon for 10 rounds. Summon Undead Beetle (WIS Spell). DC 14. Summon a giant stag beetle exoskeleton that appears within near. It stays for 5 rounds.

Petrify. CON 12+ or petrified.

Thunderclap (WIS Spell). DC 13. Fills a near-sized cube extending from siabrae. Creatures within are thrown 2d20 feet in a random direction.
